Memory values are qualified sampled process-tree PSS/private maxima, not exact peaks. Instrumented durations are not included in timing statistics.
Six-pair single-host exploratory screens are not independent qualification replications.
The candidate lacks the later span-factory and intrinsic-backing-buffer provenance fixes. These observations cannot qualify corrected source.
No outlier is removed, no warmup is relabeled, no observation is reacquired.
